review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: In this hands-on role you will be responsible for various cloud security aspects, such as network security, applicative infrastructure security and DevSecOps practices - All to ensure the security and reliability of our cloud platforms. The Requirements: Hands-on experience as a DevSecOps engineer with a deep understanding of network security, including Firewalls, WAF, PKI, SIEM, Endpoint Security, IDP, application security, and more. Proficiency in coding with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, Go, or equivalent. Strong expertise in Linux or Windows systems and related IT technologies. Collaborate closely with R&D engineering teams in designing and implementing new security features and ensuring that security requirements are incorporated from the outset.
